purpose: Actual pretrained model browser/API/persistence integration on an owned development fixture; not extraction-quality evidence

config.reason: Model review runs only when explicitly requested; proposals require a decision.

checks: Actual local Transformers provider is configured, available and nonremote
Opening the actual-model view does not invoke inference
Explicit browser request creates an asynchronous model run
Actual model generated tokens and retained its output hash
Provider and pretrained revision provenance persist
Actual inference leaves canonical facts and review version unchanged
Only one explicitly requested model inference occurred
No usable output produces an explicit failure or empty explanation
Actual model run is not labelled as an offline fixture
Canonical JSON export remains intact after the model result
The supported deterministic fixture remains exportable
Request and completion are recorded in history
